💌 From the heart

A Letter For You

My dearest Gelli Ann,

Happy Birthday, my love. 🎂 On this very special day, I want you to know that every single moment I have spent with you has been the greatest gift of my life. You came into my world quietly — first as someone I was getting to know, and then, before I even realized it, as the person I could not imagine my days without.

I remember when I first saw you, when you walked into that office as an OJT. I knew there was something different about you — something warm, something genuine — and I told myself I had to get to know you better. And the more I did, the more certain I became: I wanted you, only you.

Even when life had us pause for a moment, my heart never wavered. A week felt like forever without talking to you, and when we found our way back to each other, I knew I was not going to let that happen again. I made up my mind — I would court you, I would pursue you, and I would love you right.

January 21, 2026 — the day you became officially mine and I became officially yours. It is a date I will carry with me always. 🩷

I watched you work so hard on your thesis, and I was so proud of you every step of the way. Standing there at your graduation, watching you cross that stage — my heart was overflowing. You did it. We did it together.

We have had our ups and downs, as every real love story does. But through it all, I choose you — every single morning — without hesitation. You are my peace, my joy, my adventure, and my home.

So today, on your birthday, I hope you feel how deeply, truly, and completely you are loved. You deserve every beautiful thing life has to offer — because you, Gelli Ann, are one of the most beautiful things that ever happened to me.

Happy Birthday, my love. Here is to you, and to us. 🥂✨

💕🌸✨
Forever yours, Menard 🩷
